snippet.title: Trifoil demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
A puzzle game about drawing lines that cross, merge, and interact in unique ways. Uncover secrets, decipher symbols, and trace paths that satisfy every rule.

Trifoil by Andrew Jones @andii1701 has an updated demo out!

Trifoil in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/trifoil/
Trifoil on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085710/Trifoil/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
